turns.content: Let's play a story game. You are a dragon guarding a mountain library and I am a thief who wants one book.
The dragon lifts its head from a pile of scrolls. 'Thieves usually want gold. Which book is worth more to you than your life?'
The one with the map to the sunken city.
The dragon's eyes narrow. 'Then answer my riddle, or become part of the collection.'
